introduction: New Mexico’s 211 coverage is regional. United Way of North Central New Mexico publishes weekday helpline hours and a coverage map to identify the right service for your location.
description: New Mexico’s 211 coverage is regional. United Way of North Central New Mexico publishes weekday helpline hours and a coverage map to identify the right service for your locati

sections.who: Anyone seeking resource information can ask for a referral. Each organization receiving the referral assesses its own eligibility and available assistance.
sections.get: The service connects callers to health, human-service and community organizations. It does not award benefits or replace a provider’s intake.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Check coverage

    Use the provider’s statewide coverage map rather than assuming one center serves every county.

  2. Call the appropriate center

    North Central publishes 505-245-1735, Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m., closed major holidays. Dialing 211 is another starting route.

  3. Follow the referral

    Confirm location, current intake and needed documents with the receiving organization.
sections.after: Ask for alternatives if the referral cannot help. Keep the provider name and reason for the unsuccessful contact to support the next search.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using North Central 211 hours and New Mexico coverage map. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is every NM center open around the clock?
Do not assume so. North Central publishes weekday 8 a.m.–5 p.m. hours; check the center serving you.
The provider publishes a coverage map with regional contacts.
Does a referral approve cash assistance?
No. The receiving agency makes its own decision.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
